title: Y as a Vowel
goal: Read words where final **y** acts as a vowel: /ē/ in multisyllable words (happy, funny) and /ī/ in one-syllable words (my, fly, cry).
newToday: y = /ē/ (end of longer words), y = /ī/ (end of one-syllable words)

A.text: My puppy is very busy. / He runs and hops in the sun by the shed. / My puppy is funny — when he digs in the mud, he gets sticky and muddy. / "Silly puppy!" I said, and gave him a rub. / We go home, and my puppy is happy because he is with me.

B.text: My shift was very busy, because I ran from the front to the back and did not stop by lunch. / When I got back, there was a note from a happy person: "Thank you, you made me very glad." / I am busy, but I am glad I had a busy, happy shift.
